description: Memory arms, NL: GPT-6 Astra on 5 mechanics-15 mazes under the R2 NL cell (run_config.mechanics_15_nl.json: minimal/text_only/egocentric/zero_shot/stateless, step_by_step, progress_stall_k=30, prompt caching on), memory arm full_context (no scratchpad; the R2 NL cell unchanged). One of three configs that differ only in the memory arm: run_config.mechanics_15_nl_memory_{full_context,scratchpad_window,full_context_scratchpad}.json.
_note_no_conditions: No conditions key => single (default) cell built from experiment_config overlay. Do NOT add conditions (that would re-enable the sweep).
_note_requires: The memory field comes from the scratchpad memory PR (interface/scratchpad.py); launching before it is on the launched SHA fails at config load for the two scratchpad arms.
_note_prompt: The R2 NL prompt, unchanged: no scratchpad text anywhere.
_note_mazes: The 5 mazes where R2 NL Astra (full context, 15/15 solved) spent the most steps over the BFS optimum: M8 portals_frozen 168 vs 95, M8 death_frozen 195 vs 161, M10 (all four mechanics) 100 vs 75, M9 portals_death_frozen 103 vs 81, M8 frozen_rotating 161 vs 144. Together they cover portals, death, rotating and frozen tiles, and they are long (75-161 optimal steps), so a 5-step window drops most of the history.
_note_model_params: GPT-6 Astra exactly as in run_config.mechanics_15_nl.json (reasoning_effort=xhigh, flex tier, 64k max_completion_tokens, prompt caching on) except spend_cap_usd and worker concurrency. spend_cap_usd is a per-process hard stop (run each arm in its own process) and, like every runtime model key, enters the run hash, so these units do not reuse R2's cached episodes.
_note_cost: R2 NL measured these 5 episodes at $6.82 together (Astra flex: $1.52 M8 portals_frozen, $1.71 M8 death_frozen, $1.68 M10, $0.80 M9 portals_death_frozen, $1.11 M8 frozen_rotating; 727 queries, ~193 output tokens per query, 86% of input read from cache). Expect about the same (~$7). Worst case, every episode running to its 3x step cap (1,668 queries): ~$22. spend_cap_usd=25.
_note_launch: Local run in its own artifacts root: the three arms share run directories (keyed by task/backend/model/seed/variant, not by arm), so one root would hold only the last arm run. Pre-score Stage 2 once (no model calls): python -m scripts.run_pipeline --distributed-role coordinator-prepare --run-config gridworld/fixtures/run_config.mechanics_15_nl_memory_full_context.json --manifest gridworld/fixtures/manifest.mechanics_15.json --seeds 0 --difficulty-max-static-score 8000 --artifacts-root artifacts-memory/prescored; then cp -r artifacts-memory/prescored/tasks artifacts-memory/full_context/ and run: python -m scripts.run_pipeline --run-config gridworld/fixtures/run_config.mechanics_15_nl_memory_full_context.json --manifest gridworld/fixtures/manifest.mechanics_15.json --seeds 0 --difficulty-max-static-score 8000 --artifacts-root artifacts-memory/full_context. Serial at ~11 s per Astra query on flex (R2 NL): about 2-3 hours for the 5 episodes; the three arms can run side by side as three processes.
_note_cache: full_context and full_context_scratchpad: the history goes out one text block per step with breakpoints on the newest step and the previous request's newest step, as in R2; the scratchpad sits after the last breakpoint with the current state, so the cached prefix is the same as full_context's. scratchpad_window: the window slides every step, so only the system prompt is cached.
